delivery.chooseDistrict: Choose your district to see the exact fee and delivery time.

checkout.fixCart: Some items need your attention before you continue.

confirmed.bookmark: Bookmark this page to check your order later.
confirmed.codNote: Please have {total} ready for the courier.

confirmed.notFound: We couldn't find that order. Check the link from your confirmation, or contact us on WhatsApp.

accordion.shippingContent: Dispatched within one working day. 3–5 working days islandwide, longer to some outstation areas.
accordion.careContent: Machine wash cold, inside out. Line dry in shade. Warm iron on the reverse.
accordion.returnsContent: 7-day returns on unworn items with tags attached. Because nothing is personalised, all returned stock is resellable.

fallback.rendererFailed: 360° rotation isn't available right now — showing photography instead. You can still order.

honesty.text: This is an approximate view. See the real photographs for true colour.

toast.shared: Link copied — share it for a second opinion
toast.swatchesRequested: Swatch request noted — we'll be in touch

viewer.label: Rendered 3D preview, not a photograph: {design} design in {colour}, {material}, with {jacket} jacket material, {drape} drape. Drag or use the arrow keys to turn it.
viewer.notOffered: You can preview this, but {colour} in {material} isn’t available to order in this design yet. Choose a colour that isn’t greyed out, or the other cotton.
viewer.outOfStock: This combination is out of stock right now. Choose another colour or jacket material.

hero.headline: See it before you wear it
hero.subhead: Cotton sarees with unstitched jacket material — recolour any design, compare Plain and Super Cotton, and preview it draped either way before you buy.

osariya.heading: One saree, two drapes
osariya.body: Every saree can be draped the traditional way or as a Kandyan Osariya — same fabric, same price, same item shipped.

proof.heading: From our customers
proof.placeholderNote: Customer photo reviews will appear here once published.

pdp.colourPromiseBody: This material is photographed in natural daylight, with one unedited reference frame published for its colourway. If the delivered item differs materially from that reference, we collect it at our cost and replace or refund in full.
pdp.reviewsNone: Customer photo reviews will appear here once published.
pdp.outOfStockLabel: This colourway is out of stock.

jacketPage.title: Jacket Material
jacketPage.standaloneNote: Order jacket material on its own — no saree required.
jacketPage.deliveryNote: A flat delivery fee applies to jacket-only orders, shown at checkout before you pay.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Delivery, returns, colour accuracy and care — the questions we're asked most, answered plainly.
support.contactBody: Reach us on WhatsApp for the fastest response, or by phone during service hours.
support.colourPromiseBody: Every material is photographed in natural daylight, with one unedited reference frame published per colourway. If a delivered item differs materially from that reference, we collect it at our cost and replace or refund it in full. The Design Your Own preview is a rendered approximation and is not covered by this promise — see the honesty note in the configurator.
support.jacketStitchingBody: Your jacket material ships unstitched, cut to the piece length stated on the listing. Take it to your regular tailor along with your measurements — we don't take measurements or stitch, so any tailor of your choice can complete it.

policies.pending: This page is pending final legal review and will be published before launch. For questions in the meantime, reach us on WhatsApp.

signInEmail.subject: Your Lunara sign-in code
signInEmail.body: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
signInEmail.ignore: If you didn't ask for this code, you can ignore this email. Never share this code with anyone.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
signIn.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or request a new one.
signIn.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a moment.
signIn.claimFailed: You're signed in, but we couldn't add this order to your account. Contact us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

ops.title: Operations
ops.pricesNote: Changes apply on the next page load. Customers with the item in their cart see the change marked beside it.

error.invalid: That wasn't valid. Check the values and try again.
error.conflict: Someone else changed this first. The page now shows the latest.
error.tracking: Courier and tracking number are required to dispatch.
error.exists: That already exists: this design already has that colour in that cotton (or the jacket material already has that colour).
error.inUse: This jacket is paired in a live saree product. Archive that product or pair it with another jacket first.
error.sold: This has been sold before, so it can only be archived, not deleted.
error.stock: Not enough stock for one of the items (or it is no longer on sale). Check the Inventory page.
error.discount: A discount needs a reason and can’t be more than the shop price.
error.overpay: That is more than is still owed on this sale.
error.phone: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, e.g. 077 123 4567.
error.phoneTaken: Another customer already has that phone number.
error.planDates: Due dates must start on or after the sale date and run in order.
error.planMismatch: The instalment amounts must add up exactly to the sale total — or leave them all blank to split evenly.

messages.intro: WhatsApp and SMS messages to send by hand until those services are connected. Open, send, then mark as sent.

photos.intro: Photos are stored exactly as uploaded: no resizing, filters or colour changes. Upload sRGB JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB each, up to {max} gallery photos per colour. The first gallery photo is the cover shown in the shop.
photos.noPhotos: No photos yet — the shop shows a placeholder.
photos.referenceHint: One unretouched daylight photo with the colour target in frame. It can be set only once.
photos.referenceLocked: Set, and locked: a new fabric lot needs a new colourway record.
photos.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded.} other {# photos uploaded.}}

error.notFound: This colour no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.format: {name} is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
error.full: This gallery already has the maximum number of photos.
error.locked: The reference frame is already set and cannot be replaced.
error.network: Connection lost while uploading {name}. Try again.

reviews.intro: Every review is from a delivered order. Reply in public to criticism; never hide a review for being negative. Hide only for one of the listed reasons.

insights.intro: The success measures from the PRD (§8), from recorded orders and reviews. Every share shows its counts: with few orders, read them as counts, not trends.
insights.northStar: North star: customers who come back
insights.repeatTooEarly: Not measurable yet — no customer’s first order is {months} months old
insights.repeatNote: Customers are matched by phone number. All-time, whatever period is selected.
insights.deliveredRevenueNote: Order totals that reached the customer and were not refunded. The PRD judges growth on this, not on orders placed.
insights.superUpgradeNote: Saree units in Super Cotton. Very low means the price step is too big or not well explained.
insights.jacketAttachmentNote: {units} jacket pieces sold on their own.
insights.osariya: Kandyan Osariya drape (Design Your Own orders)
insights.osariyaNote: Ordered units only; how often the toggle is tried is measured once the configurator is live.
insights.onTimeDispatchNote: Dispatched on the day the order was confirmed or the next day (Colombo time). Target: above 98%.
insights.photoReviewsNote: {withPhotos} with photos of {reviews} published reviews; {delivered} delivered orders.
insights.returnsNote: The reason for a return is not recorded yet, so colour problems cannot be told apart from change of mind.
insights.codNote: Refusals at the door cannot be recorded yet: a dispatched order cannot be marked refused. Until then, watch cancellations.

configurator.metric: Configurator engagement, completion, toggle use and abandonment after a price rise
configurator.why: measured when Design Your Own runs on real data.

colourComplaints.why: needs a reason recorded with each complaint or return.

codRefusal.why: needs a "refused at delivery" outcome for dispatched orders.

whatsapp.why: WhatsApp is answered outside this system.

costPerOrder.metric: Cost per delivered and paid order
costPerOrder.why: needs delivery, return and marketing costs recorded.

products.intro: Add, edit and archive what you sell. Archived items disappear from the shop but keep their history; items never sold can be deleted.
products.usedIn: {count, plural, =0 {not paired with any saree} one {paired with # saree} other {paired with # sarees}}
products.newDesignName: New design name (only if you chose “+ New design”)
products.sareePrice: Saree price for this design in this cotton (LKR)
products.sareePriceNote: One price per design and cotton: changing it changes it for every colour of this design in this cotton, in the shop and in Design Your Own. The jacket add-on is added on top.
products.lowAt: Warn when stock is at or below
products.photosAfter: After saving, add photos on the Photos page.
products.archiveNote: Archive to stop selling it: it disappears from the shop and Design Your Own, and its history is kept. You can restore it any time.
products.archiveJacketNote: Archive to stop selling this jacket colour. It can’t be archived while a live saree product uses it.
products.restoreNote: Restore to put it back on sale.
products.deleteNote: Delete permanently: only possible because it has never been sold.
products.deleteConfirm: I understand this can’t be undone.
products.cannotDelete: Sold {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}: it can be archived, not deleted.
products.cannotDeleteUsed: Paired with a saree product: it can be archived, not deleted.
products.newJacketMaterialNote: For a new material, fill in all the fields below. For an existing one, leave them empty.
products.jacketPriceNote: These prices belong to {material} and apply to every colour of it.

costs.sareeNote: What one of this saree costs you to make and bring in. Customers never see this.
costs.jacketNote: What one piece of this jacket material costs you. Customers never see this.
costs.notEntered: Cost not entered yet — profit can’t be worked out.
costs.intro: Cost and profit for everything on sale. A shop product is a saree and its jacket, so its cost is both added together. Click a name to enter or change its cost.
costs.missing: {count, plural, one {# item has} other {# items have}} no cost entered yet.
costs.jacketsHeading: Jacket material sold on its own

inventory.intro: Every saree and jacket colour in one place: what you hold, what has sold online, and what it is worth. The shop reads these same numbers. Click an item to see every change to its stock.
inventory.missingCost: {count, plural, one {# item in stock has} other {# items in stock have}} no cost yet, so the value at cost is incomplete.
inventory.openingNote: Stock held when the history started

office.customerNote: If this phone number has bought before, the same customer record is used and updated.
office.name: Name
office.itemsNote: Chosen from what is on sale, at shop prices. Leave rows you don’t need empty.
office.priceNote: The total is worked out from shop prices when you save. A discount needs a reason, shown beside the price on the sale.
office.instalmentsN: {count, plural, one {# payment (in full)} other {# instalments}}
office.planNote: Leave the amounts blank to split the total evenly, or fill every amount so they add up to the total. Rows beyond the number chosen are ignored.
office.refundDue: {amount} was paid on this sale — refund it to the customer.
office.changePlanNote: Move due dates or change amounts. Amounts must add up to {total}, or leave them blank to split evenly. Payments already made stay as they are.
office.cancelNote: Puts the items back in stock. Payments stay on record so you can see what to refund.

notifications.dispatched: Lunara: order {number} is on its way with {courier}, tracking number {tracking}. Expect it in {estimate}.
notifications.dispatchedCod: Lunara: order {number} is on its way with {courier}, tracking number {tracking}. Expect it in {estimate}. Please have {total} ready for the courier.
notifications.cancelled: Lunara: order {number} has been cancelled. If you didn't ask for this, reply here and we'll help.
notifications.deliveredDay1: Lunara: we hope you love your saree! Cotton care tips: {careLink}. Returns policy: {returnsLink}. Your jacket material is unstitched — take it to your tailor to have it made.
notifications.deliveredDay3: Lunara: how is your order {number}? If anything isn't right, reply here — we're happy to help.
notifications.deliveredDay14Subject: Share a photo of your Lunara saree?

notifications.deliveredDay45Subject: A new jacket piece for your saree?
notifications.deliveredDay45: Lunara: new arrivals are in, and our jacket materials can be bought on their own to refresh a saree you already love: {jacketLink}
